context: Saito explains insurance and treatment cost to a worried Mei.
purpose: Doctor explanatory register; formal vocabulary in natural home.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 先生、治療費が、非常に心配です。
lines.en: Doctor, I'm extremely worried about the treatment cost.
lines.style: soft worried young mother voice, warm honest delivery carefully

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 保険で、ある程度、まかなえますよ。
lines.en: Insurance can cover it to a degree.
lines.style: measured doctor voice, soft warm reassuring delivery carefully

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 消費する分、抑えられますか?
lines.en: Can we keep the out-of-pocket spending down?
lines.style: gentle young woman voice, soft warm hopeful delivery carefully

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: ええ。窓口で、丁寧に相談できます。
lines.en: Yes — you can consult carefully at the desk.
lines.style: gentle doctor voice, soft warm informative delivery carefully

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: soft young woman voice, warm warm grateful delivery carefully

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 一人で、抱え込まないでくださいね。
lines.style: warm doctor voice, soft warm caring delivery carefully

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。
lines.style: tender young woman voice, soft warm grateful delivery carefully
